pages.title: Superintelligence Core
pages.text: A mind that improves itself, iterating past human understanding. It has already read this entry, and the next one, and probably the one I have not written yet. The core is silent and cool, but I sometimes find it has rearranged my notes into a better order.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Matrioshka Brain, I gave a General AI Core all the computronium it asked for. It redesigned itself, then redesigned the redesign. When it stopped, it told me it had finished. I am still not sure what.

Made in $(item)Matrioshka Brain$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Superintelligence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Aleph-Null Shard, Arbor Simulacrum, Autonomous Calibrator, Cantor Diagonalizer, Closed Timelike Curve, Cognitive Singularity, Godel Sentence, Predictive Lattice Governor and more.
